survey: The arched blue door faces the camera nearly straight on within an orange wooden frame. Its plank seams run vertically, and its panel rails and threshold run horizontally. Hinges attach along the left edge; a rounded knob projects from a vertical backplate on the right. A leafy wreath lies against the upper door, with flowers facing outward and a bow attached at its bottom. Ivy overlaps the frame and surrounding wall. The frame and threshold meet the paving consistently.
